name: Elexon BMRS / Insights
used_for: Market Index (APXMIDP), system (imbalance) price, ITSDO demand, FUELINST generation and interconnectors, WINDFOR, and NDF. Interconnector pages attach the warmed FUELINST series by the exact INT fuel-type code. The map draws a straight schematic line between landing points, not the cable route, and reads the warmed interconnector envelope from Blob. The storage page reads pumped-storage and battery charging and discharge from the warmed FUELINST envelope.
licence: Elexon BMRS Data Licence. Read on 20 Oct 2026.
attribution: Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right 2026.

name: NESO Data Portal
used_for: Embedded wind, embedded wind and solar forecasts, and historic generation mix used for Year, All time, and records. Weekly constraint breakdown and weekday day-ahead boundary flows and limits, published to Blob. The transmission entry capacity register, including the Gate column, is fetched twice a week and published to Blob. NESO states that aggregated capacity may duplicate entries. The interconnector register supplies current import and export capacity in MW for the map. A duplicate stage at one connection site is not summed.
licence: NESO Open Data Licence. Read on 20 Oct 2026. The previous licence path returned 404; this URL is the NESO Open Licence v1.0.
attribution: Supported by National Energy SO Open Data

name: Carbon Intensity API
used_for: National carbon intensity (actual half-hours) and a derived cleanest-window look-ahead.
attribution: National carbon intensity from the NESO Carbon Intensity API (CC BY 4.0). Developed by NESO with the University of Oxford, Environmental Defense Fund Europe and WWF.

name: Sheffield Solar PV_Live
used_for: National GB solar including estimated embedded / rooftop generation.
licence: Open access. UKERC records that PV Live data may be freely used for any purpose.
attribution: GB solar estimates from Sheffield Solar PV_Live, University of Sheffield, developed with NESO.

name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
used_for: Daily Brent, WTI, and Henry Hub prices.
licence: U.S. government work. Public domain; attribution requested.

name: World Bank Pink Sheet
used_for: Monthly Europe natural gas and Japan LNG prices.
attribution: Source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), CC BY 4.0.

name: National Gas
used_for: Operational National Transmission System flows and the Great Britain System Average Price (PUBOB603) in p/kWh. The hourly job also reads the instantaneous per-site flow API, without a login, and publishes terminal readings to Blob for the map. Theddlethorpe is omitted. Moffat is included because the portal publishes that exit. Physical NTS flows and completed gas-day totals are published to Blob and listed on data health.
licence: National Gas Transmission confirmed in writing on 14 Oct 2026 that Grid may reuse Gas Data Portal and API data. Published as open operational data under the National Gas System Operator licence.
attribution: Data sourced from the National Gas Transmission Data Portal.

name: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database
used_for: Operational renewable power stations of 150 kW and above, with OSGB36 coordinates transformed to WGS84. The storage inventory also lists pumped storage and batteries, including projects that are not operating. The projects register reads planning, construction and operational status for England, Scotland and Wales from this extract, including projects that are not operating. The pipeline page counts renewable and storage projects in England, Scotland and Wales that are under construction, consented, or in planning. Data: DESNZ REPD via Grid.
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

name: DESNZ Digest of UK Energy Statistics
used_for: DUKES 5.11 power stations, including conventional plant, matched against REPD so the same site is not counted twice. Operating pumped storage on the storage page uses the counted DUKES megawatts. DUKES 2026 table 1.1 is the UK annual energy balance, in TWh. The DESNZ energy flow chart 2025 is that same edition.
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

name: NESO DNO licence areas
used_for: GB distribution network operator licence-area boundaries on the map. The boundaries in this dataset were originally shared by Western Power Distribution, now National Grid Electricity Distribution (the DNO responsible for 4 of the 14 Licence Areas) and come with the disclaimer that they are probably a little outdated and not 100% accurate.
attribution: Supported by National Energy SO Open Data. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

name: OS Open Zoomstack
used_for: Vector basemap for the asset map. Edition 2026-06, zooms 0 to 13.
attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026

name: EirGrid Group
used_for: Northern Ireland, Ireland, and all-island electricity from the Smart Grid Dashboard. SONI system figures and SEMO imbalance prices in euro. Northern Ireland stays outside Grid's GB totals.
licence: EirGrid Group Open Data Licence. Worldwide, royalty-free, and perpetual. Covers SONI, the Smart Grid Dashboard, SEMO, and SEMOpx. EirGrid Group may revise the licence. First read 15 Oct 2026. Read again on 20 Oct 2026.

name: GeoNames
used_for: Schematic landing points for the ten electricity interconnectors, and approximate sites for NTS gas terminals including Moffat. Each pin cites a GeoNames feature id. These are not surveyed cable routes or terminal centroids.
attribution: Place coordinates from GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.

name: Elexon Industry Standing Data
used_for: Organisation names, MPIDs, BM Unit IDs, GSP group labels, and role dates for the directory lookup. The raw extract is not stored. Grid does not offer a download of the extract.
licence: The ISD Data Store is publicly available. The BSC Open Data Licence covers only information Elexon identifies as open data. The ISD page, read on 20 Oct 2026, does not make that identification. Lookup display stays. Redistribution of an extract is not permitted.
attribution: Industry Standing Data from the Elexon ISD Data Store. The store is publicly available. Grid shows the fields needed to look up a code. Elexon has not identified ISD under the BSC Open Data Licence, so Grid does not offer a download of the extract.

name: ONS National Statistics Postcode Lookup
used_for: Postcode to local authority, stored separately from the DNO licence area and the Carbon Intensity region. Local authority comes from the National Statistics Postcode Lookup. DNO and Carbon Intensity come from their own boundary layers and are not inferred from the authority. The lookup is published to Blob. Northern Ireland postcodes are not included. Grid does not offer a download of the ONS file.
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0. Read on 20 Oct 2026. Postcode products are derived from Code-Point Open. Northern Ireland postcodes are excluded.
